boundaries.present_at_first_frame: left-censored, not a newly observed onset
boundaries.single_point_or_corrupted_evidence: exclude affected anchor windows with reasons

contact.end_exclusive: first following frame without raw presence for that object
contact.onset: first frame of each qualifying contiguous contact run, per object
contact.raw_presence: gripper-object geom pair with dist <= 0 m and efc_address >= 0

evidence: new synchronized recordings only; no labels transferred to Sylvest videos

grasp.candidate_onset: earliest frame of a five-frame confirmation window
grasp.candidate_overlap: earliest confirmed onset wins per object until grasp ends; retain diagnostics
grasp.continuation: after confirmation, stationary holds remain grasp while one finger contacts object and reference-relative pose stays within exit limits
grasp.end_exclusive: first frame losing all finger contact OR exceeding either exit pose limit; no bridging; reference is accepted onset
grasp.failed_or_incomplete_confirmation: ambiguous grasp candidate; not automatically none
grasp.motion_measure: maximum displacement from window start over frames t..t+4
grasp.rotation_measure: SO(3) geodesic angle; no quaternion-sign dependence
window_conditions: at least one finger contacts the same movable object at every frame
both finger sides contact that object on at least three of five frames
object position relative to grip-site frame stays within 5 mm of window start
object orientation relative to grip-site frame stays within 10 degrees of window start
grip site moves at least 10 mm OR rotates at least 10 degrees from window start

gripper_close.semantics: retain existing command-transition plus aperture-response rule

objects.finger_sides: Panda important_geoms left_finger and right_finger sets
objects.gripper: collision geoms under the exact gripper root body
objects.identity: source_id plus exact model object root body; geom ownership by ancestry
objects.include: objects_dict entries with a free joint on their root body
objects.unmapped_or_multiply_owned_geom: quarantine affected frames; never infer by proximity

prompt_rules.next_event: earliest admitted onset strictly after anchor
prompt_rules.none: complete 32-frame future window with no admitted onset and no unresolved candidate

quality_gate.failure: stop; changes require a new predeclared version, preserve failed QA
